Class SimplePlexCommand

java.lang.Object
dev.plex.command.SimplePlexCommand
All Implemented Interfaces:
PlexCommand
public abstract class SimplePlexCommand extends Object implements PlexCommand
Convenience base for module commands with typed Brigadier command trees.
